sources.footstep_range_m: No figure on the Valorant wiki (https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Spike says only that the explosion radius is 'about the same as the player's audio range'). 50 m is community testing of running footsteps, cited by https://www.switchbladegaming.com/valorant/platinum-to-diamond-guide/ from GGameChamps. Owner to check.
sources.guns: Silenced guns (Ghost, Spectre, Phantom): 'Firing sound can't be heard at 40m+ except in direction of fire' on https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Ghost , https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Spectre and https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Phantom (the direction-of-fire exception is ignored). No wiki weapon page gives a range for unsilenced guns; 1000 m means heard anywhere on the map. Owner to check.
sources.gun_names: The 21 names in shot rows of the 462 replay rounds in local Postgres (2026-10-02). 'Compact Pistol' has no wiki page under that name (probably the Bandit's internal name) and gets default_gun_m; a shot with no gun (2,660 shots) uses default_gun_m.
